provenance.model: CPF LIFE Standard fixed-payout illustration; deterministic monthly cash-flow model
provenance.officialExample: Male member turning 55 in 2026; age 65 in 2036
provenance.rateUnit: Effective annual decimal, unless a field explicitly states monthlyRate; multiply annual decimals by 100 for percentages
provenance.precision: Source binary64 values retained without display rounding; official quoted inputs are illustrations
provenance.timing: Month 0 is age 65 with no payout; first payment at end of month 1; age 80 includes 180 payments
provenance.assumptions: Fixed SGD 1780 monthly payout; no later contributions or other flows; no payout reinvestment
provenance.refund: Standard premium refund max(330100 - cumulative payouts,0); pooled premium interest is not added to the refund
provenance.irr65: Household IRR: SGD 330100 initial outflow at age 65, monthly payouts and one terminal refund
provenance.irr55: Household IRR: SGD 220400 initial outflow at age 55; first payout in month 121; age-65 premium transfer is not deducted again
provenance.incomeIRR65: Income-only IRR from age 65; terminal refund excluded
provenance.householdTotal: Cumulative payouts plus terminal refund are lifetime cash flows, not wealth still held or a liquid surrender balance
provenance.portfolioSampling: Months 0,12,...,480 plus each exact first-shortfall month; all sampled values copied from validated monthly CSV
provenance.portfolioAssumptions: Constant effective annual net SGD return; monthly growth then withdrawal up to SGD 1780; capital floors at zero; no additional fees, taxes, FX or later capital
provenance.scenarioScope: 0%,2.5%,4% are illustrative discount/portfolio rates, not available product promises; OA/RA reference rates do not imply freely accessible substitute accounts or CPF LIFE investment returns
provenance.npvScope: Income and household NPV at stated rate; finite funding figures are present values through selected age, not insurance annuity quotations
limitations: Payouts assumed unchanged for illustration; actual estimates/payouts may be adjusted.
No mortality weighting, expected return, risk adjustment, inflation adjustment of nominal IRRs, tax relief, liquidity valuation or future capital flows.
Do not apply Standard bequest formula to Basic. No invented Basic or Escalating quotes.
No age70premium is known here; age70household IRR and full deferral comparison are intentionally absent.

deferral.scope: Undiscounted income-only catch-up using the two supplied official fixed payout illustrations; excludes bequests, changed premium and opportunity cost.

qa.precisionEdgeCase: At month 1, incomeIRR65 is -1.0 due to binary64 rounding of an annual rate extremely close to -100%; preserve as source value and do not use it in a new log(1+r) calculation
